question: What understanding arises regarding the deity during this practice?
premises: A notion arises in the practitioner.
The notion relates to an image.
inference: In the deity, the notion of an image arises.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal intent of pratimā-buddhiḥ in this context is ambiguous.
plain_english: O fair-hipped one, in the deity the notion of an image arises.
